title: Workflow rules
summary: How Claude works day to day: plan mode, asking questions, picking skills, usage-limit wake-up timer, setup-change notices.
details: This rule shapes how Claude works day to day: it enters plan mode automatically when a task will touch 3 or more files, picks fitting skills without being asked, prefers editing existing files over creating new ones, asks you its questions through the AskUserQuestion tool and never starts a bare interpreter. It also covers the usage-limit wake-up timer and telling the other active sessions on this PC after a setup change. It loads as a text rule in every session; no code runs.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
